mainTopic: Which קרבנות need סמיכה, and whom the שעיר המשתלח atones for
overview: The amud opens by finishing a question about נסכים: how much wine goes with a ewe? The answer comes from a משנה in שקלים, and a ewe gets the same amount as a lamb. Then a new משנה teaches that communal offerings usually have no סמיכה, except the פר העלם דבר and the שעיר המשתלח. רבי שמעון adds the goat for עבודה זרה. Private offerings do need סמיכה, except בכור, מעשר and פסח, and an heir acts as the owner. In the גמרא, רבי יהודה and רבי שמעון argue over which offering is the second of the two communal סמיכות that tradition requires. Their argument turns on whether the שעיר המשתלח atones for the כהנים too. רבי יהודה says it does, so the כהן גדול counts as an owner. רבי שמעון says the כהנים are atoned through their own פר. Finally, two ברייתות about סמיכה on the goats of עבודה זרה seem to contradict each other in רבי שמעון's name, and that contradiction continues on the next amud.

steps.title: How much wine for a ewe's libations?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks what amount of נסכים is brought with a female sheep.
steps.simpleTranslation: The libations of a ewe: how much are they?
steps.whatsHappening: A question is being asked: how much wine (and flour and oil) goes with a female sheep? This sets up the answer in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The תורה gives different amounts for a lamb (כבש) and a ram (איל). A female sheep is not clearly listed in either group, so we don't know which amount she follows.

keyTerms.meaning: Libations: the wine (with flour and oil) brought along with an animal קרבן
A ewe, a female sheep
How much? What amount?

phrases.english: The libations of a ewe, how much are they?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes a question carried over from the previous amud (the speaker reports that he was asked this and answered it).
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Does a ewe get the amount of a lamb or of a ram?

steps.title: Answered from the token system in the משנה
steps.stepSummary: The speaker answers from a משנה: the token marked 'גדי' covers all sheep except rams, so a ewe gets a lamb's amount.
steps.simpleTranslation: And I answered him from a משנה: a token marked 'Kid' is used for the libations of sheep, big ones and small ones, males and females, except for rams.
steps.whatsHappening: The question is answered by quoting a משנה about the tokens used to buy wine for נסכים in the בית המקדש.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The 'גדי' token was for the smaller amount, the amount for young sheep. Since it covers females too, and only rams are left out, a ewe needs the same amount as a lamb, not a ram.

keyTerms.meaning: I resolved it, I answered the question
Kid, the word marked on one of the purchase tokens
Flock animals (sheep and goats)
Rams, which need a bigger amount of נסכים

steps.whatToRemember: A ewe's נסכים are the same as a lamb's. Only a ram gets more.

phrases.english: And I resolved it for him from a Mishnah:
phrases.notes: The משנה is in שקלים, about tokens people bought in the מקדש and then traded in for wine.

phrases.english: 'Kid' serves for the libations of flock animals
phrases.notes: 'Kid' is the word marked on the token. It is not talking about an actual goat here.

phrases.english: of big ones and of small ones,
of males and of females,
except for those of rams.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question of step 1.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: A ewe's נסכים equal a lamb's, because the 'גדי' token includes females and leaves out only rams.

steps.title: Communal offerings have no סמיכה, with two exceptions
steps.stepSummary: The new משנה rules that קרבנות הציבור don't get סמיכה, except the פר העלם דבר and the שעיר המשתלח.
steps.simpleTranslation: משנה: All communal offerings have no placing of hands, except the bull brought for all the מצוות, and the goat that is sent away.
steps.whatsHappening: A new משנה begins with the topic of סמיכה. It says communal offerings normally don't get it, and names two exceptions.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The first exception is the bull brought when the סנהדרין ruled wrongly and the community sinned. The second is the goat sent away on יום כיפור (the שעיר לעזאזל).

keyTerms.meaning: Our משנה
Offerings brought on behalf of the whole community
Pressing one's hands on the head of the animal before it is slaughtered
The bull brought when the community sinned through a mistaken ruling of the סנהדרין (also called פר העלם דבר)
The goat sent away on יום כיפור

steps.confusionAlert: Don't mix up the two goats of יום כיפור. Only the goat that is sent away gets סמיכה. The goat that is offered inside does not.

phrases.english: MISHNAH:
All communal offerings,
there is no placing of hands on them,
except for the bull
that comes for any of the מצוות,
phrases.notes: It comes when the community did any sin because the סנהדרין ruled wrongly. See ויקרא 4:13–21.

phrases.english: and the goat that is sent away.

steps.triggerLanguage: כׇּל קׇרְבְּנוֹת הַצִּבּוּר אֵין בָּהֶן סְמִיכָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts a new משנה on a new topic (סמיכה).
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Communal offerings get no סמיכה, except the פר העלם דבר and the שעיר המשתלח.

steps.title: רבי שמעון adds the goat for idol worship
steps.stepSummary: רבי שמעון holds that the communal goat brought for עבודה זרה also gets סמיכה.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי שמעון says: also the goat brought for idol worship.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי שמעון adds a third exception to the list of communal offerings that do get סמיכה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: When the community worships idols because of a wrong ruling by the סנהדרין, a goat is brought. The first opinion did not list it, but רבי שמעון says it also gets סמיכה.

keyTerms.meaning: The goat the community brings for idol worship caused by a mistaken ruling of the סנהדרין
Also, even

phrases.english: Rabbi Shimon says:
also the goat of idol worship.

steps.triggerLanguage: רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר אַף שָׂעִיר עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Adds to the list of exceptions in step 3.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to רבי שמעון, the communal goat for עבודה זרה also gets סמיכה.

steps.title: Private offerings need סמיכה, except three
steps.stepSummary: All קרבנות היחיד need סמיכה, except the בכור, the מעשר and the פסח.
steps.simpleTranslation: All offerings of an individual need placing of hands, except the firstborn, the animal tithe, and the קרבן פסח.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה turns to private offerings. Here the rule is the opposite: they do need סמיכה, with three exceptions.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For communal offerings the basic rule is 'no סמיכה'. For private offerings the basic rule is 'yes סמיכה'. The בכור, מעשר and פסח are left out even though they are private offerings.

keyTerms.meaning: Offerings brought by one person
Require, need
A firstborn animal, given as a קרבן
Animal tithe, every tenth animal
The Pesach offering

steps.whatToRemember: Communal offerings: usually no סמיכה (except the פר and the שעיר המשתלח). Private offerings: usually סמיכה (except בכור, מעשר and פסח).

phrases.english: All offerings of an individual
require placing of hands,
except for the firstborn
and the tithe and the Pesach offering.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves from communal offerings to private offerings.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Private offerings need סמיכה, except the בכור, the מעשר and the פסח.

steps.title: The heir acts as the owner
steps.stepSummary: An heir does סמיכה, brings the נסכים, and can make a תמורה.
steps.simpleTranslation: And the heir places his hands, brings the libations, and can make a substitution.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה teaches that when an owner dies, his heir steps into his place for this קרבן.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Normally only the owner does סמיכה. Here the heir counts as the owner, so he does סמיכה, brings the נסכים, and if he tries to swap a regular animal for the קרבן (תמורה), the swap takes effect.

keyTerms.meaning: Heir, the one who inherits
Places his hands (does סמיכה)
Makes a תמורה: tries to swap a regular animal for a קרבן, which makes the regular animal holy too
Substitution of an animal for a קרבן

phrases.english: And the heir places his hands,
and brings libations,
and makes a substitution.
phrases.notes: Swapping is forbidden. But if he does it, the new animal becomes holy, and the original stays holy too.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Adds who may do the סמיכה for a private offering: the heir as well.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: An heir counts as the owner for סמיכה, נסכים and תמורה.
steps.whyThisMatters: The heir takes the owner's place completely for this קרבן. He does סמיכה, brings its נסכים, and can even make a תמורה.

steps.title: רבי שמעון: the bull and the idolatry goats get סמיכה
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא quotes רבי שמעון. No communal offering gets סמיכה except the פר for all the מצוות and the goats for עבודה זרה.
steps.simpleTranslation: The גמרא: The Rabbis taught: All communal offerings have no סמיכה, except the bull that comes for all the מצוות and the goats of עבודה זרה. These are the words of רבי שמעון.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא begins by quoting a ברייתא that gives רבי שמעון's full list of the communal offerings that need סמיכה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The general rule is that קרבנות הציבור have no סמיכה. רבי שמעון makes two exceptions: the פר העלם דבר and the goats brought when the community mistakenly worships עבודה זרה. This matches his view from Step 4.

keyTerms.meaning: The discussion that explains the משנה
Offerings brought on behalf of the whole community
Leaning one's hands on the animal before it is slaughtered
The bull brought when the community sins by mistake in almost any מצוה (the פר העלם דבר)
The goats brought when the community sins by mistake with idol worship

phrases.english: GEMARA: The Rabbis taught:

phrases.aramaic: כׇּל קׇרְבְּנוֹת הַצִּבּוּר אֵין בָּהֶן סְמִיכָה,
phrases.english: All communal offerings have no placing of hands,

phrases.aramaic: חוּץ מִפַּר הַבָּא עַל כׇּל הַמִּצְוֹת
phrases.english: except for the bull that comes for all the מצוות
phrases.notes: This is the bull the community brings for a mistaken ruling in almost any area of the תורה.

phrases.english: and the goats of idol worship;
these are the words of Rabbi Shimon.

steps.triggerLanguage: תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: כׇּל קׇרְבְּנוֹת הַצִּבּוּר אֵין בָּהֶן סְמִיכָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Brings a ברייתא that expands on the משנה's dispute about communal סמיכה
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to רבי שמעון, the only communal offerings with סמיכה are the פר for all the מצוות and the goats of עבודה זרה.

steps.title: רבי יהודה swaps in the שעיר המשתלח
steps.stepSummary: רבי יהודה says the idolatry goats have no סמיכה, and he names the שעיר המשתלח as the second case instead.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יהודה says: The goats of עבודה זרה have no סמיכה. So which one shall I bring in their place? The שעיר המשתלח.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יהודה disagrees with רבי שמעון. He takes the idolatry goats off the list and puts the שעיר המשתלח on it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Both תנאים agree on the bull. They argue only about the second case. רבי יהודה's words 'which shall I bring in their place' show that he feels the list must have two items.

keyTerms.meaning: The scapegoat sent away to עזאזל on יום כיפור
In their place

phrases.english: Rabbi Yehuda says:

phrases.aramaic: שְׂעִירֵי עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה אֵין בָּהֶן סְמִיכָה,
phrases.english: The goats of idol worship have no placing of hands,
and which shall I bring in their place?
The scapegoat.

steps.triggerLanguage: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר: שְׂעִירֵי עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה אֵין בָּהֶן סְמִיכָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: The opposing view within the same ברייתא
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to רבי יהודה, the second communal offering with סמיכה is the שעיר המשתלח, not the idolatry goats.

steps.title: Why must רבי יהודה add a replacement?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא interrupts the ברייתא and asks why רבי יהודה can't simply leave the list with only one item.
steps.simpleTranslation: Is it not possible without bringing in another case?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא pauses the ברייתא to ask a question. Why does רבי יהודה go looking for a substitute instead of just removing the goats?
steps.deeperAnalysis: If the goats don't get סמיכה, the simple result would be that only the bull does. The גמרא wants to know what forces רבי יהודה to find a second case.

keyTerms.meaning: Is it not possible without...
Bring in, insert (another case)

phrases.english: Is it not possible not to insert another case?
phrases.notes: This refers to רבי יהודה's words 'which shall I bring in their place'.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Questions the wording of רבי יהודה's statement
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Why רבי יהודה needs two communal סמיכות and is not satisfied with one.

steps.title: A tradition of exactly two communal סמיכות
steps.stepSummary: רבינא answers that there is a received tradition of two סמיכות in the ציבור.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבינא said: We have a tradition of two סמיכות for the community.
steps.whatsHappening: רבינא answers the question. There is a tradition that the community has exactly two offerings with סמיכה, so removing one means another must take its place.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The count of two is fixed by tradition, not worked out by reasoning. So רבי שמעון and רבי יהודה only argue about which offering fills the second slot.

keyTerms.meaning: We have learned it as a tradition
Two cases of סמיכה for communal offerings

steps.whatToRemember: The number of communal offerings with סמיכה is fixed at two. The only argument is which two.

phrases.english: Ravina said:
It is learned as a tradition: two placings of hands for the community.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רָבִינָא: גְּמִירִי שְׁתֵּי סְמִיכוֹת בְּצִבּוּר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question of Step 9
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: There is a tradition of exactly two communal סמיכות, so רבי יהודה must name a second case.

steps.title: רבי שמעון: סמיכה is only by the owners
steps.stepSummary: רבי שמעון challenges רבי יהודה. סמיכה is done only by the owners, yet the כהן גדול leans on the שעיר המשתלח.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי שמעון said to him: But סמיכה is only done by the owners, and on this one אהרן and his sons do the סמיכה!
steps.whatsHappening: Back in the ברייתא, רבי שמעון attacks רבי יהודה's choice of the שעיר המשתלח.
steps.deeperAnalysis: There is a rule that only the בעלים, the ones who get atonement from the offering, do סמיכה. The כהן גדול leans on the scapegoat, but רבי שמעון assumes he is not one of the ones atoned for by it. So the leaning on it cannot be the usual offering סמיכה.

keyTerms.meaning: The owners of the offering, the ones it atones for
אהרן and his sons, meaning the כהן גדול of each generation

phrases.english: Rabbi Shimon said to him:
But isn't it so that placing hands is only by the owners,
and this one, Aaron and his sons place hands on it!
phrases.notes: He means the כהן גדול leans on it even though, in רבי שמעון's view, it does not atone for him.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Returns to the ברייתא after the interruption and attacks רבי יהודה's view
steps.kashyaTarget: רבי יהודה's counting of the שעיר המשתלח as a communal סמיכה
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: סמיכה requires the owners. The כהן גדול who leans on the scapegoat is not atoned through it, so it does not qualify.

steps.title: רבי יהודה: the כהנים are atoned too
steps.stepSummary: רבי יהודה answers that אהרן and his sons also get atonement through the שעיר המשתלח, so they count as owners.
steps.simpleTranslation: He said to him: This one too, אהרן and his sons are atoned through it.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יהודה defends his view. The כהן גדול is one of the people the scapegoat atones for, so his סמיכה is done by an owner.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי יהודה accepts the rule that only owners do סמיכה. He disagrees with the facts: in his view the scapegoat atones for the כהנים along with everyone else. So the whole argument comes down to whom the שעיר המשתלח atones for.

keyTerms.meaning: Receive atonement

phrases.english: He said to him:

phrases.aramaic: אַף זֶה – אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו מִתְכַּפְּרִין בּוֹ.
phrases.english: This one as well: Aaron and his sons are atoned through it.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר לוֹ: אַף זֶה – אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו מִתְכַּפְּרִין בּוֹ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers רבי שמעון's challenge
steps.terutzResolutionType: Denies the factual assumption of the question
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The כהן גדול is not atoned by the שעיר המשתלח, so his leaning is not owner's סמיכה.
steps.terutzMaskana: The כהן גדול is atoned by it together with the community, so he counts as an owner and the סמיכה is valid.

steps.title: Each follows his own known view
steps.stepSummary: רבי ירמיה says רבי שמעון and רבי יהודה are each consistent with their views elsewhere.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי ירמיה said: And they follow their own reasoning.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי ירמיה remarks that this argument fits each תנא's known opinion. This line sets up the next part of the גמרא, which will show where those views come from.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The argument over whether the scapegoat atones for the כהנים is not new here. It matches a broader disagreement between these two תנאים, which the גמרא is about to show.

keyTerms.meaning: They follow their own reasoning, each consistent with his own view elsewhere

phrases.english: Rabbi Yirmeya said:
And they follow their own reasoning.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Connects the argument of Steps 11-12 to the תנאים's broader positions
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The dispute over whether the כהנים are atoned through the שעיר המשתלח matches each תנא's established view.

steps.title: The ברייתא reads the פסוק as a list of everyone and everything atoned for
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא brings a ברייתא that explains each phrase of ויקרא 16:33. It identifies the places in the מקדש and the groups of people that receive atonement on יום כיפור.
steps.simpleTranslation: As it is taught: 'He shall atone for the holy sanctuary' means the קודש הקדשים. 'And the אהל מועד' means the היכל. 'The altar' means what it says. 'He shall atone' means the courtyards. 'The priests' means what it says. 'For all the people of the congregation' means ישראל. 'He shall atone' means the לויים.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a ברייתא to prove רבי ירמיה's point from step 13. This first part breaks the פסוק into pieces and says what each piece refers to. It is setting up רבי יהודה's conclusion in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Every place and every group named in the פסוק is listed side by side. רבי יהודה will use this shared list to say they all share one atonement. The extra word 'יכפר' is read as adding the courtyards, and the second one as adding the לויים.

keyTerms.meaning: The innermost room, the קֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים
The Sanctuary, the main hall in front of the Holy of Holies
The courtyards of the בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ
According to its plain meaning

phrases.english: As it is taught: “And he shall atone for the holy sanctuary”
this is the innermost sanctum;
phrases.notes: Literally 'inside and inside,' meaning the very innermost room, the קודש הקדשים.

phrases.english: “and the Tent of Meeting” – this is the Sanctuary;
“the altar” – as it sounds;
“he shall atone” – these are the courtyards;
“the priests” – as it sounds;
“for all the people of the congregation” – these are the Israelites;
“he shall atone” – these are the Levites.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Brings the ברייתא that backs up רבי ירמיה's claim that both תנאים are consistent with their views
steps.raayaObject: רבי ירמיה's claim that רבי יהודה and רבי שמעון each hold the same view elsewhere

steps.title: רבי יהודה: everyone shares one atonement through the scapegoat
steps.stepSummary: רבי יהודה concludes that all the groups in the פסוק are equal. All of them get atonement through the שעיר המשתלח.
steps.simpleTranslation: They are all equal in one atonement: they are all atoned for by the שעיר המשתלח. These are the words of רבי יהודה.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יהודה says the פסוק puts כהנים, ישראל and לויים together, so they all share the same atonement, the שעיר המשתלח.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This explains רבי יהודה's answer in step 12. The כהנים are atoned through the שעיר המשתלח too. So the כהן גדול counts as one of its owners and may do סמיכה on it.

keyTerms.meaning: They were made equal
The scapegoat sent away on יוֹם כִּפּוּר
Atonement

steps.whyThisMatters: This is the source showing that רבי יהודה really holds the כהנים are owners of the שעיר המשתלח. That is the basis for his view about סמיכה.

phrases.english: They are all equated to one atonement,
that they are atoned for by the scapegoat,
phrases.notes: This means for all sins other than making the מקדש or its holy foods טמא.

phrases.english: the words of Rabbi Yehuda.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Draws רבי יהודה's ruling from the list in the פסוק
steps.mimraCoreRuling: כהנים, ישראל and לויים are all atoned for through the שעיר המשתלח

steps.title: רבי שמעון: the priests get atonement through the bull instead
steps.stepSummary: רבי שמעון disagrees. The כהנים have a parallel atonement through the פר of the כהן גדול. The blood of the פר covers טומאה of the מקדש, and the confession over the פר covers other sins.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי שמעון says: The blood of the goat brought inside atones for ישראל for making the מקדש and its holy foods טמא. In the same way, the blood of the bull atones for the כהנים for that sin. The confession over the שעיר המשתלח atones for ישראל for all other sins. In the same way, the confession over the bull atones for the כהנים for other sins.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי שמעון explains that the כהנים do not use the שעיר המשתלח for atonement. Their own פר does both jobs for them.
steps.deeperAnalysis: He sets up two pairs. For טומאה, the goat's blood works for ישראל and the bull's blood works for כהנים. For other sins, the confession over the שעיר המשתלח works for ישראל and the confession over the bull works for כהנים. So for רבי שמעון the כהן גדול is not an owner of the שעיר המשתלח, which explains his challenge in step 11.

keyTerms.meaning: The goat whose blood is sprinkled inside the Holy of Holies

steps.whatToRemember: רבי יהודה says the כהנים are atoned by the שעיר המשתלח, so the כהן גדול is an owner. רבי שמעון says they are atoned by the פר, so he is not.

steps.title: But the verse lists everyone together
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks how רבי שמעון deals with the פסוק. It clearly lists כהנים and ישראל together as if they were equal.
steps.simpleTranslation: And according to רבי שמעון, weren't they certainly made equal?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges רבי שמעון. The same פסוק puts all the groups side by side, so why doesn't he agree they share one atonement?
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי יהודה built his view on the list in the פסוק. If רבי שמעון splits the כהנים off, he seems to ignore the fact that the פסוק groups them all together.

keyTerms.meaning: Certainly

phrases.english: And Rabbi Shimon – weren't they certainly equated?
phrases.notes: He means: the פסוק lists them all together, so they must be equal in some way.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges רבי שמעון's view using the ברייתא's reading of the פסוק
steps.kashyaTarget: רבי שמעון's view that the כהנים have a separate atonement
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The פסוק lists all the groups together, which suggests one shared atonement

steps.title: They are equal only in getting atonement, each in its own way
steps.stepSummary: Yes, they are grouped together, but only because all of them receive atonement on יום כיפור. Each group gets its atonement through its own offering.
steps.simpleTranslation: Yes, they are equal in that they all receive atonement. But each one gets atonement through its own offering.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers for רבי שמעון. The פסוק lists everyone together only to show that all of them get atonement, not that they get it the same way.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The 'equality' is redefined. For רבי יהודה it means one shared atonement. For רבי שמעון it only means everyone is included in the atonement of the day. The כהנים are atoned through the פר, and ישראל and the לויים through the goats.

steps.whatToRemember: Both תנאים agree the פסוק groups everyone together. They argue over what that grouping means: one atonement for all (רבי יהודה), or everyone atoned, each in his own way (רבי שמעון). That is exactly what decides whether the כהן גדול may do סמיכה on the שעיר המשתלח.

steps.title: Summary of the two opinions on atonement for כהנים
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא sums up the מחלוקת. Both agree that the פר atones for the כהנים for טומאת מקדש וקדשיו. They argue only about other sins: for רבי יהודה the כהנים are atoned by the שעיר המשתלח, and for רבי שמעון by the וידוי over the פר.
steps.simpleTranslation: According to רבי יהודה: for making the מקדש or its קדשים טמא, ישראל get atonement through the blood of the goat that is brought inside, and the כהנים through the bull of אהרן. For other sins, both groups get atonement through the confession over the שעיר המשתלח. According to רבי שמעון: for other sins too, the כהנים get atonement through the confession over the bull.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is wrapping up the last few steps by laying out side by side exactly what each תנא holds.
steps.deeperAnalysis: There are two kinds of sin here: טומאת מקדש וקדשיו, and all other sins. On the first kind, both תנאים agree: ישראל are atoned by the goat's blood and the כהנים by the blood of the פר. The only argument is over other sins: רבי יהודה says everyone is atoned through the שעיר המשתלח, while רבי שמעון says the כהנים have their own atonement through the וידוי over the פר.

steps.confusionAlert: Don't think רבי יהודה says the כהנים have nothing of their own. He agrees the פר atones for them for טומאת מקדש. He only says that for other sins they share the שעיר המשתלח with ישראל.

steps.title: A משנה that teaches רבי יהודה's view
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא shows this מחלוקת is already taught in a משנה. רבי יהודה says ישראל, כהנים and the כהן גדול are all the same, except that the blood of the פר atones for the כהנים for טומאת מקדש וקדשיו.
steps.simpleTranslation: As it is taught: ישראל, כהנים and the anointed כהן are all the same. What is the difference between them? Only that the blood of the bull atones for the כהנים for טומאת מקדש וקדשיו. These are the words of רבי יהודה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא quotes a משנה to show that the summary it just gave matches what רבי יהודה says there.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה says the three groups are equal, with one exception: the blood of the פר atones for the כהנים for טומאת מקדש. That fits the summary exactly. For רבי יהודה, the כהנים have their own atonement only for טומאה, and for every other sin they share the שעיר המשתלח with everyone else.

steps.title: The same משנה teaches רבי שמעון's view
steps.stepSummary: The משנה goes on: רבי שמעון makes two matching pairs. The goat's blood atones for ישראל and the פר's blood for the כהנים, and the confession over the שעיר המשתלח atones for ישראל and the confession over the פר for the כהנים.
steps.simpleTranslation: And רבי שמעון says: just as the blood of the goat brought inside atones for ישראל, so the blood of the bull atones for the כהנים. Just as the confession over the שעיר המשתלח atones for ישראל, so the confession over the bull atones for the כהנים.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא keeps quoting the same משנה, now with רבי שמעון's side. It matches the summary given for him.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי שמעון makes the כהנים fully parallel to ישראל. Blood matches blood for טומאה, and confession matches confession for other sins. So for him the כהנים never need the שעיר המשתלח.

steps.title: Only the communal bull needs סמיכה, not the goats for עבודה זרה
steps.stepSummary: A new section. A ברייתא learns from the פסוק that the bull brought for a communal sin needs סמיכה, but the goats brought for communal עבודה זרה do not. This is the view of רבי יהודה.
steps.simpleTranslation: The רבנן taught: "And the elders of the congregation shall lean their hands on the head of the bull." A bull needs סמיכה, but the goats for עבודה זרה do not need סמיכה. These are the words of רבי יהודה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא starts a new topic. It brings a ברייתא that explains רבי יהודה's view in our משנה about which communal offerings need סמיכה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק names the bull when it says the elders lean their hands on it. רבי יהודה reads this as limiting the rule: only the bull needs סמיכה, and the goats brought when the community worshipped idols do not. The משנה recorded that רבי שמעון disagrees, so expect his reading next.

steps.title: רבי שמעון: the goats need סמיכה, but by the כהן גדול
steps.stepSummary: רבי שמעון holds that the פר needs סמיכה by the זקנים. The goats of עבודה זרה need סמיכה too, but by אהרן, not by the זקנים.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי שמעון says: the bull needs placing of hands by the זקנים. The goats brought for עבודה זרה do not need placing of hands by the זקנים. Instead, אהרן does it.
steps.whatsHappening: The ברייתא from step 22 continues with רבי שמעון's opinion. He disagrees with רבי יהודה about the goats of עבודה זרה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי יהודה said the goats need no סמיכה at all. רבי שמעון says they do need סמיכה. The פסוק only singles out the פר to teach who does it: the זקנים. For the goats, it is done by אהרן, meaning the כהן גדול.

steps.title: A second ברייתא about the live goat seems to clash
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא brings another ברייתא on the words 'the live goat'. There רבי יהודה again says the goats of עבודה זרה need no סמיכה. רבי שמעון says the live goat needs סמיכה by אהרן, and his statement continues past this point.
steps.simpleTranslation: The גמרא contrasts this with another source. The פסוק says 'the live goat'. This teaches that the live goat needs placing of hands, but the goats of idol worship do not. These are the words of רבי יהודה. רבי שמעון says: the live goat needs placing of hands by אהרן...
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is setting up a contradiction by quoting a second ברייתא. The clash becomes clear only when רבי שמעון's words are finished, right after this point.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In this ברייתא, רבי שמעון reads 'the live goat' as teaching that the שעיר המשתלח needs סמיכה by אהרן. That reading suggests other goats get their סמיכה from someone else. This would not fit with step 23, where he said the goats of עבודה זרה get סמיכה by אהרן.
